ui.claim_strip_body: Claim it to fix the listing yourself — venue, price, description — and keep it accurate going forward.
ui.claim_justification_prompt: No specific promoter is listed for this event, so it can't verify automatically. Tell us why this listing is yours — an admin will review it.
ui.claim_justification_placeholder: e.g. I organize this recurring night at this venue…
ui.claim_pending_fienta_body: Paste this code into your event's description or its "Notes about time" field on Fienta. We check for it automatically, or check now for an instant answer.
ui.claim_pending_dns_body: Add this TXT record to your domain's DNS, then check back here — DNS changes can take a few minutes to appear.
ui.claim_pending_review_body: An Event Radar admin will check your claim and email you the outcome. There's nothing more for you to do right now.
ui.claim_pending_review_hint: Admin-review claims expire after {days} days if no admin has resolved them — come back any time to check the status.
ui.claim_pending_approved_body: This event now belongs to you in Event Radar. Edit the listing any time from your dashboard.
ui.claim_pending_dormant_note: A duplicate claimed listing currently takes precedence over this one, so editing is paused. It resumes automatically once that's resolved.
ui.claim_pending_automated_hint: Nothing is lost if you close this page — we keep checking in the background. This expires after {days} days of inactivity.
ui.claim_cancel_confirm: Cancel this claim? The event will stay open for anyone else to claim.
ui.claim_cancelled_body: You've cancelled this claim. You can claim this event again any time from your dashboard.
ui.claim_expired_body: This claim expired after {days} days without verification. You can start a new claim from your dashboard.
ui.claim_revoked_body: An admin has revoked this claim. Contact us if you think this is a mistake.
ui.claim_declined_body: This claim couldn't be verified. You can claim again from your dashboard, or contact us if you think this is a mistake.
ui.claim_edit_intro: Fields you edit here are pinned and stop syncing from the source. Everything else keeps updating automatically overnight.
ui.claim_edit_price_hint: Your price is authoritative and shown everywhere — we just flag it when the source has since changed.
ui.claim_edit_price_mismatch_body: The source now lists a different price. Your saved price stays in effect until you accept the new one.
ui.claim_edit_save_needs_fix: Saved, but this edit didn't pass our publish checks — the event is off the public site until it's fixed.
ui.claim_edit_locked_body: This claim isn't granted yet — editing unlocks once it is.
ui.claim_edit_dormant_body: A duplicate claimed listing for this event currently takes precedence, so editing stays locked. It unlocks again automatically once that's resolved.
ui.claim_edit_categories_hint: Up to {max} in total. Your additions never remove a category the event already has.
ui.claim_edit_categories_full: This event already has {max} categories, so there is nothing to add.
ui.claim_edit_save_hint: A failing edit stays off the public site until it's fixed — no email, just this page.
ui.claim_edit_error_end_before_start: End time can't be before the start time.
ui.claim_edit_error_price_order: Min price can't be greater than max price.
ui.claim_events_intro: Every event Event Radar currently links to this publisher. Open one to edit its pinned fields.
ui.claim_events_empty_msg: This publisher has no matching events on Event Radar right now.
ui.price_free_options_hint: Free options available for some groups — check ticket conditions.
ui.digest_desc: Receive your Daily Five by email each morning.
ui.digest_off: Email digest is off. You can re-enable it any time.
ui.consent_label: Include ads in my Daily Five email
ui.consent_desc: At most one event an organizer paid to show, below your picks and marked “Ad”. It’s never chosen from your interests. We count opens of the ad only as anonymous totals. Turn it off here or from any email that carries one.
ui.logout_all_desc: Sign out everywhere — useful if you think your sign-in link was shared or your session was compromised.
ui.logout_all_success: Signed out of all devices. Redirecting…

ui.sign_in_modal_save_body: We'll remember it's yours — but not what you clicked to get here.
ui.sign_in_modal_foryou_body: For-you ranks events against what you've saved and liked.
ui.explore_upsell_body: Bookmark or rate a few and your feed shifts around them from the next visit on — no quiz, no setup.
ui.saved_empty_msg: Events you bookmark, like, or dislike will show up here.
ui.saved_error: Failed to load saved events. Please refresh.
ui.landing_hero_h1: Five events worth _leaving the house_ for.
ui.landing_hero_sub: Event Radar scans every venue, ticket site, and gallery in Tallinn, then emails you five events matched to your taste. Every morning.
ui.seo_landing_title: Event Radar — Daily Events Guide for Tallinn
ui.seo_landing_description: Discover five hand-picked events in Tallinn every day — concerts, exhibitions, workshops, and nightlife matched to your taste. Free daily email, no tracking.
ui.landing_step1_body: Tell us the kind of entertainment you like — clubs, galleries, workshops, family days.
ui.landing_step2_body: Every venue, ticket site, and gallery in Tallinn, processed and ranked for you.
ui.landing_step3_body: Five events matched to your taste, waiting each morning.
ui.landing_showcase_sub: A taste of what Tallinn has on this week.

ui.landing_hero_counter: {count}+ events on the radar right now
ui.landing_personas_title: Built for how you actually go out

ui.landing_organizer_title: Put your event on the radar.
ui.landing_organizer_body: List your event yourself. It goes on the feed within seconds, and it stays yours to edit.
ui.legal_draft_body: This page is a draft and not yet in force. The details in highlighted brackets are filled in by the Operator before the terms are published.

ui.sponsored_explain_none: This is a paid ad. We picked it by the day and page, never your interests. The order of results is unchanged.
ui.sponsored_explain_daily5: This is a paid ad and not one of your five. It was not chosen from your interests.
ui.sponsored_daily5_caption: Separate card, not one of your five

ui.promo_page_sub: Pay for a labelled place beside the results for one of your events.
ui.promo_what_is: A Promotion puts one event you own in front of more people for 3 to 14 days in a row. It shows as a separate card marked “{label}” with your business name, beside the normal results and never inside them.
ui.promo_get_explore_desc: One card in fourth place on page 1 of Explore.
ui.promo_get_daily5_desc: One extra card after a reader’s five picks. It is never one of the five.
ui.promo_get_digest_desc: A block below the picks in the Daily Five email, sent only to readers who switched on ads in their email settings.
ui.promo_fact_who_value: Registered Estonian businesses and non-profits. We check your registry code against the business register.
ui.promo_fact_length_value: 3 to 14 days in a row, starting tomorrow at the earliest.
ui.promo_promise_1: Your event’s normal position in Explore and Daily 5 doesn’t change.
ui.promo_promise_2: Up to five Promotions take equal turns in the slots. We don’t predict reach, and we can’t promise views, clicks or ticket sales.
ui.promo_empty_msg: Open Your events and choose Promote on a published event. Your requests and Promotions will appear here.
ui.promo_reason_requested: Waiting for review. We’ll email you when it’s decided.
ui.promo_reason_paused: Paused today because {reason}. It resumes by itself once this is fixed.
ui.promo_reach_sub: Different people who had your event in their Daily 5 during the whole window, each counted once.
ui.promo_report_foot_1: “Shown” means your card was placed on a page or in an email. It doesn’t mean anyone saw it.
ui.promo_report_foot_3: Opens are visits to your event page from the card or the email block. We don’t track email opens.
ui.promo_report_foot_4: Nothing is guaranteed. These figures show what happened, not what will.
ui.promo_report_foot_5: We never show who saw your card.
ui.promo_form_sub: Pick your dates and your business. The card on the right is what readers will see.
ui.promo_form_event_note: Fixed: you opened this from Your events
ui.promo_date_rules: 3 to 14 days in a row. Earliest start is tomorrow, latest end is your event’s last day ({date}).
ui.promo_picker_hint: Greyed days are full or outside your event.
ui.promo_err_start: The first day must be tomorrow or later.
ui.promo_err_end: A Promotion can’t run past your event’s last day ({date}).
ui.promo_err_order: The end date must be on or after the start date.
ui.promo_err_len: A Promotion runs 3 to 14 days in a row. Yours is {days}.
ui.promo_err_full: {date} is fully booked. Choose a window that avoids it.
ui.promo_err_need_dates: Choose a start and an end date.
ui.promo_reg_hint: The 8-digit code from the Estonian business register.
ui.promo_legal_from_register: Filled in from the business register. It can’t be edited.
ui.promo_legal_hint: As it appears in the business register. This name goes on the card.
ui.promo_lookup_invalid: That isn’t a valid registry code. Check the 8 digits.
ui.promo_lookup_deleted: This company is deleted from the business register, so it can’t buy a Promotion.
ui.promo_lookup_not_found: We couldn’t find that code in the business register. Check the digits.
ui.promo_lookup_outage: We can’t verify the business right now.
ui.promo_billing_hint: Invoices go here. If you leave it empty we use {email}.
ui.promo_note_placeholder: Anything we should know when we look at this
ui.promo_review_title: This event needs a quick review before it can be promoted.
ui.promo_review_msg: Send a request instead. We’ll look at the event and email you with a decision. Nothing is charged.
ui.promo_outage_title: We can’t verify the business right now.
ui.promo_outage_msg: Card payment needs a verified business. Send a request instead: enter the registry code and legal name, and we’ll check them by hand.
ui.promo_policy_label: I confirm this event follows the {link}.
ui.promo_fix_errors: Fix the highlighted fields to continue.
ui.promo_need_terms: Accept the Organizer terms to continue.
ui.promo_need_policy: Confirm the content policy to continue.
ui.promo_need_legal: Enter the legal name as it appears in the register.
ui.promo_hold_note: We hold your days for {minutes} minutes while you pay. Pay on the secure Stripe page; we never see your card.
ui.promo_request_note: We review requests by hand. If we grant it, we email an invoice and hold your days until it’s paid. Nothing is charged by card.
ui.promo_total_none: Choose your dates to see the total.
ui.promo_sent_msg: We’ll review it and email you a decision. You can withdraw it from Promotions while it’s pending.
ui.promo_ok_msg: Your Promotion is scheduled. It starts on {date}, and the VAT invoice is on its way to your inbox.
ui.promo_confirming_msg: This usually takes a few seconds. You can leave this page: your Promotion appears in Promotions as soon as the payment is confirmed.
ui.promo_late_note: If a payment ever reaches us after your held days have lapsed, we refund it in full automatically and email you.
ui.promo_reason_awaiting_payment: Granted. We emailed you an invoice. Your days stay held until it’s paid.
ui.promo_reason_awaiting_payment_to: Granted. We emailed an invoice to {email}. Your days stay held until it’s paid.
ui.promo_reason_awaiting_checkout: Card checkout started. Your days stay held while you pay; if you don’t finish, they’re released.
ui.promo_reason_declined_plain: We couldn’t approve this request. You can send a new one.
ui.promo_report_empty: No complete days yet. The first day appears tomorrow.
ui.promo_why_slots_disabled: Promotions are switched off for now
ui.promo_why_bot_user_agent: the request came from a known bot
ui.promo_why_event_not_canonical: your claim on this event is inactive because a better-quality duplicate of the event exists
ui.promo_why_organizer_not_owner: your claim on this event is inactive
ui.promo_why_restriction_unassessed: the event is waiting for a content check
ui.promo_why_restriction_flagged: the event needs a content review before it can show
ui.promo_why_filters_mismatch: the page’s filters don’t match your event
ui.promo_why_unknown: a check we run before showing it didn’t pass
ui.promo_err_overlap: This event already has a Promotion in these dates.
ui.promo_err_pending: This event already has a request waiting for review.
ui.promo_err_daily_limit: You’ve sent a lot of requests today. Try again tomorrow.
ui.promo_err_not_promotable: This event can’t be promoted right now.
ui.promo_err_terms: Accept the Organizer terms to continue.
ui.promo_err_policy: Confirm the content policy to continue.
ui.promo_err_checkout: We couldn’t open the secure checkout. Please try again.
ui.promo_card_unavailable: Card payment isn’t available right now. Send a request instead and we’ll invoice you.
ui.promo_form_unavailable_title: This event can’t be promoted right now
ui.promo_form_unavailable_msg: It may already have a request or a Promotion, or it no longer qualifies. Go back to Your events.
ui.promo_err_full_any: Some of these days are fully booked. Choose another window.
